lines.t: An arrow from the enemy struck me...
I had let down my shield to rest, and that is when he shot...
For he had been waiting for the opportune moment, and when it came, he did not hesitate...
No mercy was shown by him...
For he takes delight in my affliction...
His companions who were nearby saw it, and laughed...
They also mocked me as I fell to the ground...
It was because of my listless wandering,
that I had forgotten The Way...
And because I had been walking aimlessly and without purpose,
I had fallen into the hands of my enemy...
For in his zealousness to murder, he had been hunting me...
Yet I did not know it...
He had relentlessly stalked me as a lion stalks his prey...
Yet I was unaware of it...
For in my self-seeking I had lost sight...
And in my idleness, I became weary and faint hearted...
So I took off my armor to ease the burden...
Because of my senselessness, I had become hungry...
When I searched, I spotted fruit amongst the thorns...
So I gathered it, and ate...
Yet my hunger did not cease...
It had only increased within me...
Dehydration consumed me also...
Wherever I searched, no clean water could be found...
So I drank from the stagnant pools of water...
Yet my thirst was not quenched...
Instead of satisfaction, I was filled with emptiness...
Dread began to course through my spirit like poison...
My peace and joy had departed from me...
Suffering had become my food, and sorrow was my drink...
And I could not be satisfied...
If I had not lost sight,
I would have seen him lurking from afar...
If I had held my grip,
I would not have stumbled...
Yet there I was, wounded and fallen on the ground...
The light of life dimming, as my understanding departed from me...
Misery and tears poured into my soul...
Misery and tears poured into my soul...
My mind had become an adversary to me...
A harbor of deceit which yielded lies...
A dark and lonely place, enclosed with prison bars...
All my thoughts had turned against me...
All my musings tormented me, without ceasing...
My enemy showed no pity in his ambush...
My eyes were blindfolded...
I was bound by chains...
He looked upon me with eyes of hatred...
Malicious words proceeded continually from his mouth...
He grabbed all hope by the neck and strangled it...
Agony and despair had overtaken me...
My prayer was for death...
My longing was for nothingness...
Yet you, oh Lord, had not forgotten me...
Nor had you utterly forsaken me...
Your voice had traveled to the farthest reaches...
Your love and mercy had found me, even in the deepest depths of darkness...
When I remembered The Lord, I cried out to Him with all my heart...
Grace entered me, and I received strength...
As I began to arise, I perceived that I was not bound...
I also remembered the sword which He had given to me...
There it was, resting securely in its sheath, which was at my side...
I took hold of its handle and recalled the mighty and awesome works of The Lord...
Truth had surrounded me...
And I believed it...
Light began to dawn as my sight was returning...
As His Words came to remembrance, the deafness of my ears began to dissipate...
As I trusted Him, peace began to fill my heart...
Though I had departed from The Way,
His love still pursued me...
And though I had despised Him,
He showed mercy, and drew near to me...
Understanding was granted to me, and I beheld my escape...
The chains which had constrained me, had become like dust...
The bars which had confined me, were revealed to be a lie...
As I embraced Him, the darkness fled...
There was much pleasure in His eyes as He bound up my wounds...
His presence was serenity and healing...
A love which this world does not know...
He was also full of light...
He then took my hand and led me in righteousness...
His path was holiness to The Lord...
The darkness cried out behind me...
Yet I did not look back...
Nor did I have any desire to look to the left hand nor to the right...
I kept my gaze fixed toward The Goal in front of me...
